import dataclasses
import hashlib
import unittest

from solution import CredentialRecord, create_credential


class CredentialTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_creation_normalization_exact_encoding_and_verification(self):
        salt = b"\x00\x01salty"
        record = create_credential("User_9", "  Local@Example.COM  ", "pässword🔐", salt)
        digest = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac("sha256", "pässword🔐".encode("utf-8"), salt, 20000)
        expected = "pbkdf2$20000$" + salt.hex() + "$" + digest.hex()
        self.assertEqual(record.handle, "User_9")
        self.assertEqual(record.address, "local@example.com")
        self.assertEqual(record.encoded_secret, expected)
        self.assertIs(record.verify_secret("pässword🔐"), True)
        self.assertIs(record.verify_secret("pässword"), False)
        self.assertIs(record.verify_secret(None), False)

    def test_salt_is_copied(self):
        salt = bytearray(b"original")
        record = create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", "secret", salt)
        encoded = record.encoded_secret
        salt[:] = b"mutated!"
        self.assertEqual(record.encoded_secret, encoded)
        self.assertTrue(record.verify_secret("secret"))

    def test_immutable_dataclass(self):
        record = create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", "secret", b"salt")
        self.assertTrue(dataclasses.is_dataclass(record))
        with self.assertRaises((dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError, AttributeError, TypeError)):
            record.handle = "changed"

    def test_handle_boundaries_and_invalid_handles(self):
        create_credential("a", "a@b.co", "x", b"s")
        create_credential("A_0123456789012345678", "a@b.co", "x", b"s")
        for handle in ["", "a" * 21, "has-dash", "with space", "é", 7]:
            with self.subTest(handle=handle):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    create_credential(handle, "a@b.co", "x", b"s")

    def test_invalid_addresses(self):
        invalid = ["", "abc", "@x.com", "a@", "a@@b.com", "a@localhost", 3]
        for address in invalid:
            with self.subTest(address=address):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    create_credential("abc", address, "secret", b"salt")

    def test_secret_and_salt_validation(self):
        for secret in ["", None, b"secret"]:
            with self.subTest(secret=secret):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", secret, b"salt")
        create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", "x", memoryview(b"s" * 32))
        for salt in [b"", b"s" * 33, "salt", 4]:
            with self.subTest(salt=salt):
                with self.assertRaises((TypeError, ValueError)):
                    create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", "secret", salt)

    def test_malformed_stored_encoding_never_raises(self):
        base = create_credential("abc", "a@b.co", "secret", b"salt")
        malformed = [
            "", "plain", "pbkdf2$20000$00", "other$20000$00$00",
            "pbkdf2$19999$00$00", "pbkdf2$20000$zz$00",
            "pbkdf2$20000$00$zz", "pbkdf2$notnum$00$00",
            "pbkdf2$20000$$" + "00" * 32,
        ]
        for encoded in malformed:
            record = dataclasses.replace(base, encoded_secret=encoded)
            with self.subTest(encoded=encoded):
                self.assertIs(record.verify_secret("secret"), False)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
